WITH lpm_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    o.opsregistry,
    (t.totaldeliverytons / dh.hubcaptons) * t.deliverysuccessrate * (1 - t.vehiclebreakrate / 100.0) * 100 AS lpm_score
  FROM operations o
  JOIN distributionhubs dh ON o.opshubref = dh.hubregistry
  JOIN transportation t ON o.opshubref = t.transporthubref
)
UPDATE operations o
SET opsstatus = CASE 
  WHEN lc.lpm_score > 80 THEN 'Completed'
  WHEN lc.lpm_score >= 50 AND lc.lpm_score <= 80 THEN 'Scaling Down'
  ELSE 'Active'
END
FROM lpm_calc lc
WHERE o.opsregistry = lc.opsregistry
RETURNING o.opsregistry, o.opsdistref, o.opshubref, o.emerlevel, o.respphase, o.opsstatus, o.coordcenter, o.opsstartdate, o.estdurationdays, o.priorityrank, o.resourceallocstate, o.supplyflowstate;
